description: This simulation uses an agent-based model to simulate the spread of a virus within a population of 1000 people. Each person is modeled as an autonomous agent with specific behaviors and interactions.

behaviors.name: move
behaviors.description: Movement behavior for each agent within the environment.
behaviors.algorithm: Randomly adjust the position of the agent within the movement range each time step.

behaviors.name: interact
behaviors.description: Defines how agents interact with each other when in close proximity.
behaviors.algorithm: Agents within interaction_distance of each other interact and potentially transmit infection.

behaviors.name: transmit_infection
behaviors.description: Transmission of the virus from an infected to a susceptible person.
behaviors.algorithm: When an infected agent interacts with a susceptible agent, the susceptible agent becomes infected based on infection_probability.

behaviors.name: recover
behaviors.algorithm: Infected agents recover based on recovery_probability each time step.

interactions.name: infection_transmission
interactions.description: Transmission of the virus occurs during interaction between agents.
interactions.effect: Infected agents can transmit the virus to susceptible agents based on infection_probability.

algorithms.SIR_model: Used to calculate the number of susceptible, infected, and recovered people over time
algorithms.Random_movement: Determines random movement of agents on the grid

data_sources.name: None
data_sources.purpose: No external data is used in this simulation

files.name: main.py
files.description: Main file to run the simulation

files.name: agent.py
files.description: Defines the Person entity, attributes, and behaviors

files.name: environment.py
files.description: Sets up the grid environment and manages agent interactions

files.name: simulation.py
files.description: Controls the simulation flow and metrics tracking
